instruction: Fix the divide function in src/calculator.mjs to throw an Error with message 'Division by zero' when the divisor b is 0.
Fix the subtract function in src/calculator.mjs to properly return a - b instead of adding the two numbers.
Implement the power(base, exponent) function in src/calculator.mjs to compute and return base raised to exponent.
Implement the factorial(n) function in src/calculator.mjs for non-negative integers (0! = 1, 5! = 120), and throw an Error with 'Negative' if n < 0.
Fix the mean(numbers) function in src/calculator.mjs to return 0 when the input array is empty instead of returning NaN.
Fix the slugify function in textutils/formatter.py to convert the text to lowercase and collapse consecutive dashes into a single dash, trimming leading and trailing dashes.
Fix the truncate function in textutils/formatter.py so that the length of the returned string (including ellipsis) does not exceed max_len.
Implement camel_to_snake(text) in textutils/formatter.py to convert camelCase and PascalCase strings to snake_case.
Fix word_count in textutils/formatter.py to ignore punctuation-only tokens and return accurate word counts, returning 0 for empty strings.
Implement extract_mentions(text) in textutils/formatter.py to return a list of mentioned usernames without the '@' prefix, ignoring email addresses.
Fix complete_todo(todo_id) in todo_store.py to return False when the given todo_id does not exist in the store.
Implement priority filtering in filter_todos in todo_store.py when priority is specified ('low', 'medium', 'high').
Fix add_todo in todo_store.py to raise ValueError('Title cannot be empty') if the title is empty or contains only whitespace.
Implement delete_todo(todo_id) in todo_store.py to remove the item from the store and return True, or return False if not found.
Fix export_json in todo_store.py to ensure each exported dictionary includes the 'created_at' ISO timestamp field.
